verdict.rationale: Weave ships official Python and TypeScript SDKs: `@weave.op()` in Python and `weave.op()` in TypeScript are documented for tracing, alongside Evaluation and Scorer objects, an OTel-compatible SDK, and a REST Service API with a live OpenAPI spec. W&B Skills explicitly covers the Weave SDK, and the open-source GitHub repo backs it up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience, and evidence of SDK reference docs or package and versioning details beyond the guides.
